observations: Photo 0 shows a variety of water storage containers in an outdoor yard.
Centrally featured are white Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBC tanks) housed in galvanized steel cages.
The IBC tanks are stacked and appear to be on plastic or metal pallets.
In the background, black vertical cylindrical water tanks are visible; one is clearly branded 'GEEPEE' in photo 0.
In the foreground, the interior of a large, open-top black plastic circular tank or basin is shown.
A 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermark is present across the center of the image.

claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house
claims.evidence: The photo shows a commercial storage yard or sales point with multiple units, which contradicts the 'in our house' residential context.

risks.risk: Contamination from previous industrial or chemical use
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's original content label or a clear shot of the interior showing no residue.
Video of the tank filled with water to the brim.
Close-up video of the valve being operated under water pressure.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the label on the white tank to check for previous contents.
Video showing the tank filled with water and the valve operating.
Photo of the specific tank being sold to confirm its individual condition.
response.reason: The item is identified as a standard 1000L IBC tank. It can be priced at its lowest utility value (non-potable, potentially leaking) until proof of condition is provided.
